Smallest supported direction conclusion

Park the current D6 action-choice object family at the direction-local level. The exact unit being parked is the proposed line in which a shared Q(s,z,k) learner would be justified by finding a finite state population with materially action-relevant preferences for both k=7 and k=13.

This is not a Portfolio lifecycle decision, does not close the broader semigroup_consistent_duration_model_policy direction, and does not refute the abstract D6 architecture. It records that the currently authorized source-search lineage has no remaining executable, decision-relevant object:

A01 established action relevance but only a uniform, material k=13 preference.

A02 was the sole additional population authorized to seek an independently predicted k=7 regime.

A02 validly returned A02_EVENT_PHASE_POPULATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

The controlling prior decision prohibits a second source population, countdown sweep, sign search, learner, D6/D8 B object, or automatic derivative.

The allowlisted evidence contains no independently observed, qualitatively different mechanism sufficient to support an immediate recast or continuation. 

2026-09-04-scdmp-d6-a02-populat…

Direct observations
A01

SCDMP-D6-DURATION-ACTION-RELEVANCE-A01 established all six states and completed all 1,152 paired native missions. Every mission safe-docked; no model, training dataset, optimizer update, AdamW step, or learner evaluation existed. The exact result was:

W   = 2498
R7  = 0
R13 = 1

Every state’s best k=13 action exceeded its best k=7 action by 179–197 numerator units, versus the material threshold of 32. The result therefore selected A_ONE_SIDED_DURATION_ACTION_RELEVANCE. Its exposure line was NO_LEARNED_PARAMETERS — exposure not applicable, and valid-result machine time was 8.115556099975947 s.

The independently checked intake confirms that A01 contradicted the predicted bidirectional substrate but did not contradict D6 on every possible population. Its strongest live explanation is a simple longer-hold docking-time advantage under that source law.

A02

SCDMP-D6-EVENT-PHASE-DURATION-ACTION-RELEVANCE-A02 was prospectively frozen as the sole additional population. It compared opposed renewal alignments at countdowns 7 and 78, using six base states, two clock policies, balanced HR/RH events, and sixteen paired tapes. Its card explicitly prohibited a second population or countdown sweep and specified that no branch itself authorized B.

The one accepted A02 invocation validly selected:

A02_EVENT_PHASE_POPULATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED

Both source trajectories completed, but the required K7-tick-273, countdown-78, clock-7, HR mission safe-docked before its scheduled event. The frozen first-match rule stopped after 321 candidate missions. The partial inventory was 320 timeouts, 1 safe dock, and zero native failures. No model, dataset, optimizer, AdamW step, or learner evaluation existed.

No K_{b,d}, K_d, state-count, SHORT_ALIGNMENT, or LONG_ALIGNMENT quantity was produced. Those quantities are unobserved, not zero. A02 therefore establishes population non-establishment, not absence, reversal, or nonmateriality of an event-phase duration effect.

Inference and object-family boundary

The two valid A results imply only:

The stationary/post-event A01 population is materially one-sided in favor of k=13.

The sole prospectively admitted event-phase A02 population could not support its all-cells estimand because one required event occurred after native termination.

No valid evidence establishes a population with material action-linked preference for both durations.

No D6/D8 learner comparison is presently decision-relevant under the previously selected action-choice rationale.

The conclusion is therefore to park, rather than close, the D6 action-choice family. Parking is warranted because no authorized next object exists; closure would be too broad because A02 supplied no duration-policy contrast and A/RECON evidence does not establish structural impossibility.

The exact finite A01 and A02 questions are answered at their frozen meanings. They must not be rerun, repaired by replacing population coordinates, or extended into another source/countdown search under this decision.

Assessment of a qualitatively different recast

No such recast is supported by the allowlisted evidence.

The direction authority records historical temporal ancestry from event/duration-order noncommutation, rate/accounting controls, and coordinated renewal, but expressly transfers no numeric or scientific polarity from those sources. It also mentions historical eligibility of an outcome-blind EBCR replacement after technical repair. That summary does not provide the treatment, competent comparator, finite population, current observable, result map, or direct observation needed to form a new meaning-complete direction object from the present manifest. Turning that ancestry into a new recast here would require filling gaps from unlisted evidence and would evade the node’s evidence boundary.

The current direction record itself concludes that A01 remains the only action-value sign, A02 supplies no missing opposed substrate, and no B, second population, countdown sweep, replacement state, or automatic derivative is authorized. It identifies the present decision as parking versus a recast supported by evidence outside the exhausted lineage; it records no such independent recast evidence.

The separate Portfolio A1 headroom measurement is unobserved. Its absent headroom value is not zero, but it cannot supply mechanism polarity, an MEI, B authorization, or a direction decision. No unapproved 5% or 25% MEI is applied.

Strongest support

The strongest support for parking is the conjunction of three direct facts:

A01 was not borderline or heterogeneous: all six contrasts materially favored k=13 within a narrow 179–197 range.

The sole independently motivated A02 population failed before its contrast estimand existed.

The prior complete Pro decision admitted exactly that one A02 population and explicitly prohibited any second source population, countdown sweep, learner, B object, or automatic derivative.

There is consequently no authorized internal discriminator left in this object family.

Strongest contradiction

The strongest contradiction to closure is that A02 was not an adverse duration result. One late-state mission terminated before the event, while earlier groups proceeded to terminal outcomes. Event-phase responsiveness may still have native value in some representable population. The frozen all-cells estimand, however, does not permit salvaging the partial inventory, moving the event, replacing the late state, or interpreting the absent contrasts.

This contradiction is why the family is parked rather than declared scientifically false or structurally closed.

Residual uncertainty

The evidence leaves unresolved whether:

another naturally occurring, independently defined environment contains both shorter- and longer-duration action regimes;

a representable event calendar would make six ticks of response latency consequential;

D6 cross-k sharing would improve sample efficiency, merely regularize the model, cause negative transfer, or do nothing;

D8 would be competent at a matched budget; or

a qualitatively different temporal mechanism could support a new direction object.

None of those uncertainties creates current launch authority.

The evidence specification permits transparent A/B adaptation and says adverse evidence normally updates the smallest implicated unit. It does not require broad direction closure. Conversely, adaptation is not a license to disregard an explicit one-population stopping boundary or to relabel another sign search as a new mechanism.

Exact re-entry condition

The parked D6 action-choice family may return to this convergence node only after a committed, independently generated evidence record outside the A01/A02 source-state and countdown-search lineage satisfies all of the following:

Qualitatively distinct mechanism: it identifies a mechanism other than selecting another source state, event countdown, target tick, host-neighbour row, or duration-sign population.

Pre-outcome population basis: its population and coordinates were fixed for reasons independent of the A01 R7=0 result and A02 population failure.

Native action consequence: it directly establishes, or supplies a non-search prospective reason to test, state-dependent duration choices that can change a competent action or native return—not prediction error alone.

Decision relevance: it explains which direction decision would differ between the possible result branches.

Class-correct object: any learned B proposal must run the complete real environment, learner, trainer, and evaluator; report nonzero transition, update, and evaluation counts; use fresh data; and contain no A result as a pre-learner launch gate.

Permitted B launch conditions only: common integrity, nonzero learner activity, fresh resource admission, and the machine-generated treatment-parameter exposure line. Section 11.4 allows no additional launch hold.

Satisfaction of those conditions would reopen convergence; it would not automatically authorize the proposed object.

Historical theorem/control ancestry, the partial A02 inventory, another state or countdown choice, the unmeasured A1 headroom item, or a proposed MEI does not satisfy this condition.

Finite claim ceiling

This decision supports only:

On the exact .92/.25 SCDMP host, the valid A01 population supplied material one-sided k=13 action relevance, while the sole additional A02 event-phase population was not established. Under the controlling stopping boundary, the current D6 action-choice object family has no authorized and presently decision-relevant next object and is therefore parked direction-locally.

It does not establish:

absence of event-phase duration value;

D6 or D8 competence;

benefit or harm from cross-k parameter sharing;

sample efficiency, regularization, or negative-transfer causation;

unseen-duration transfer;

semigroup or duration invariance;

D2 interruption value;

general MARL performance;

safety, deployment, or flight readiness;

any Portfolio lifecycle, priority, capacity, fusion, registration, ownership, or investment decision.
